about_the_game:
thankyou

It's an indie game that my friends and I made.

He will give you some land and soldiers in the early stage. There is no need for early development time, and you can directly enter the battle.

The map was made with reference to the history of World War II Europe. Increase the sense of substitution. (Haha, I'm familiar with the map of Europe)

Most of the game takes squares and hexagons. But I miss the style and style of the plot occupation very much, and here I have made it happen - "Plot Staining"

Factions are bound to strengthen the sense of cooperation with teammates. You can open a room to connect to the Internet

But this is an indie game, and we've focused our research on the online side. All members of the production team generate electricity for love, and there are many shortcomings, which will be updated step by step!

If you need to do World War II map events, you can also contact us.

In short, if you like plot staining open online WW2 co-op just give it a try.

When the player enters the game level, they can move the soldier to occupy the plot of land in another country, build a defensive or economic building, and then click on the second turn.

1v1 player play can drag on indefinitely. So the game is limited to 20 rounds, and there are points statistics in the upper right corner of the game.

It also minimizes the risk of player defeat aversion.

The game's story is inspired by World War II in Europe.

"Script" currently has original 1v1 map, 3v51939 map, 1v3 Mediterranean, 1v1 German and French map (if there is any map or storyline you want to play, please contact us.) ）

Since the server supports the online function, ask your friends to wait for you in the room hall, and the "room number" is the account number of the host.

The first screen, "Login", initially enters the login and registration screens, which require access to the database from the server.

The second screen, "Room", is to find a room or create a room. The room is automatically locked as soon as the game starts, making it easier for one person to play. Click your seat again to change seats.

The third interface, Table, is the main scene of the map game.

The indie game. In terms of program, it is divided into three parts: the database, the server side, and the client.

Other technical cloud servers, distribution platforms.

If you have any maps or storylines that you would like to play, or if you have any suggestions for stats that need to be adjusted, please contact me ...
